title: CHI 2025 paper receives a Best Paper Honorable Mention
summary: “The System is Made to Inherently Push Child Gambling in my Opinion”: Child Safety, Monetization, and Moderation on Roblox, by Yubo Kou, Rie Helene (Lindy) Hernandez, and Xinning Gui, received a Best Paper Honorable Mention at CHI 2025.
